name: WoW Panel
author: Plinth
description: Your character on the panel: portrait, level, spec and guild, professions with skill progress, the reputations you've pushed lately, mount and pet counts, your latest achievement — and the ones only a step or two from done.

properties.name: clientId
properties.label: Battle.net client ID
properties.help: Create a client at develop.battle.net → API Access. Both the id and the secret are needed — they pay for the whole card: every panel reads Blizzard's character APIs with them.

properties.name: clientSecret
properties.label: Battle.net client secret
properties.help: The client secret for that same Battle.net application. It buys the short-lived token every character panel reads with, and is never sent anywhere but Battle.net's sign-in endpoint.
